We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "One of our agents noticed that searching for a record they'd just created returned nothing and asked me to look into why."

We need to explain why newly created record might not appear in search: indexing delay, resolves within minutes; if still after several minutes, report. Use DOC-035 excerpts.

Thus answer: explain that search index updates shortly after creation, may lag a couple minutes; browsing shows record; usually resolves; if persists beyond several minutes, report.

Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"When a record is created, the browse view shows it immediately, but the search index is updated a short time later. It’s normal for a newly‑created record to be missing from search for a few minutes while the index catches up. In most cases it will appear on its own within a couple of minutes. If the record still isn’t showing up after several minutes, that’s not the expected indexing lag and you should report it so we can investigate further."}
